text: Morning handover is a mess because the stand numbers and gate numbers keep getting mixed up. I only need the passenger gates on this version. Keep the three B gates, put a little departures heading over them, and move the bus stand off to the side with some breathing room. B14 is reserved for the delayed Madrid flight now; write Madrid, time unknown. Please leave AZ418 where it is. That crew is already boarding and I do not want anyone thinking we moved them. Can the reserved gate be amber rather than green? Whatever you call amber here is fine.
The yellow one at the far end needs a wheelchair symbol beside it, big enough for the relief dispatcher to spot.
B14: change empty to IB672.
You made the entire pier green. I said B12 was boarding. Put the background back to grey and leave just that gate green.
b16 out of use till 1430 pls cross it out dont delte the flight number
The bus stand looks like a fourth gate at the moment. A separate section down there would save us explaining it every shift.
Swap the flights at the ends.
Does a 45-minute connection in Frankfurt actually give you enough time?
Okay so gate bee fourteen is the one we need to hold no sorry not hold close close that gate and put the Madrid people down at the bus stand with a line showing where they go

I drive the Sunday relief and this is for the notice in the cab, so no street detail please. The 24 skips the market while the road is dug up. Show it going from the library to a temporary stop called Baths, then on to the hospital. Leave Market visible with a note that it is closed Sundays. I would like the diversion dashed if that still reads when printed in black and white. Also a small note saying normal route resumes Monday. We have had three drivers follow the old sheet already.
That red stop is the terminus. Put a turning loop after it.
Extend the 24 from Hospital to West Park, sorry East Park. West Park is the school service.
Reverse all four stops.
At the library the change of bus is made. Please give there two rings, that the passenger sees he can change.
and the last bus time underneath
market stop shld be hollow its pick up only not the big blue dot
Make the station connection shorter.
Can you check whether the 24 is running this bank holiday? The council website is useless.

Can we make this useful for the night dispatcher? North sends into the hub at half five, South at six, those are correct. The returns flow is backwards though: the cage sends back to the hub for sorting. Reverse that arrow and write returns only on it. Below both depots I need a spare-driver box, shared by the two, with dotted links so nobody reads it as another trunk run. No driver names yet. We are still waiting for the agency list.
Split the green depot into two boxes, same place, one for vans and one for bikes.
No, 12 is the fleet size, not twelve separate depots. Get rid of the copies and put 12 vans back inside North.
South has eight sorry seven vans today one is in the garage so seven available and if you can put the broken one just outside with a little spanner or something
I cannot tell which departure is earlier without reading the tiny times. North above South in a single column might help.
Remove Returns. Actually keep the cage, just take away its arrow until we agree who collects it.
Box the two depots together. Label it Local fleet.
Text Gary that the South load is late, please.

Coach here. We have eight teams on the sheet but Jets pulled out last night. Tigers get the bye; do not shuffle everyone else because the parents have already arranged lifts. Can that bottom match say Tigers — bye, and can Tigers appear in Semi 2? No winner on the other side yet. Leave enough space inside the final for us to write a score on the printout. We are using this on a clipboard in the rain, so bigger text everywhere would be appreciated.
The two yellow matches need court numbers: Court 1 on the upper one, Court 2 on the lower.
Falcons won 3–1. Wait, 3–2, the last goal counted. Put them through.
Why are the Owls in the semi? They lost. Falcons should be on that line.
Move Bears above Falcons.
foxes r u14 not u12 put u14 in brackets after the name pls
There is nowhere for the losers of the semis to play for third. We usually have that match before the final.

I do not know the right name for the format. Everyone should get at least two games, but I also want a final people can watch. There are six teams: Red, Blue, Gold, Green, Black and White. Could you sketch two little groups of three, with the top team from each meeting in the final? Maybe that is enough. Show all the group games too, because I have to book pitches. If it turns out to be too busy we can change it.

This is for Saturday at the food bank. Bea can only stay until ten now, so her morning box is misleading. Split the welcome desk morning into eight to ten and ten to twelve, keep Bea in the first half and leave the second half visibly empty. Omar is still doing the whole morning in the kitchen. I am trying not to guilt anyone into extra hours; could the gaps say help welcome rather than urgent? The red afternoon kitchen box can change to that wording too. Leave Liv as she is.
Put my name, Nessa, in that red gap. Same size as everyone else.
Um Liv and Bea are swapping no not their jobs just their times Bea does twelve till four and Liv does eight till twelve keep them both on welcome
Omar is prevented for the morning. Make his place free, but do not suppress his name; write beside it that he is absent this Saturday.
Add cleanup, 16–17. Two empty slots.
Put Bea with Liv.
Thanks. Honestly people have been very generous with their weekends.
Could we have a version that does not show who is missing? I want to put it on the public noticeboard and the names are more than visitors need.

I am taking over as secretary and I am not convinced this is an org chart at all. Mina chairs meetings; she is not Rob and Eve’s boss. Could the three committee roles sit together across the top, with no arrows between them, and Jo underneath as the contact for playing matters? Keep the coaches under Jo for now. Put a heading over the top row that says Elected committee. I might be overthinking it, but new members keep taking this literally.
The green box should have two names inside it: Fran and Yusuf. They share that job.
Add safeguarding under the captain — no, it needs to sit independently beside the committee. Name is Helen.
You have made Jo chair as well as captain. Mina is still chair. Please just restore the top box; the rest is fine.
under the treasurer, a little
can we loose the arrows? lines yes but no pointy ends its a club not the army
The junior coaches look as if they report to the captain for safeguarding as well. That is not how we work. There needs to be a separate route straight to Helen.

Could you draw me something for our book club? There are only nine of us, so calling it a structure feels ridiculous. Ana does the venue, I collect the money, and whoever picked the book leads that month. Maybe a circle of members with those jobs written outside it? I do not want myself at the top just because I started the chat. The other names are Ana, Ben, Chi, Dory, Ewan, Fatima, Gus and Holly; I am Val. Have a go and I will know better when I see it.
